name: Brumal-Transept
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past solar wind erosion patterns, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
There is money in rare flora here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
